title: MISSION #214 NIROBI, KENYA May the Acts of the Apostles continue! #IUICWorldBlitz
cleanTitle: MISSION NIROBI, KENYA May the Acts of the Apostles continue!
segments: >> Sun hot, but the SCRIPT RUN COLDER.
FLYING PURPLE LINE on the border. WHOLE
They tried to stone the prophet, still
we rise. Dust on the boots, fire in
Israel united in Christ. That's our sign
ON THE CORNER. LINE on line.
Purple be a problem, they know.
From the blocks to the coast, we roll.
